scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 16 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: Crisis News and Chun Yuqiao's Collapse
scenes.summary: Stuck in weekend traffic with faulty livestream gear, Kaiwen calls Bu Xiaogu just as word arrives that their lead guest's adopted brother went missing in an overseas attack, and Xiaogu discovers Chun Yuqiao unconscious on his office floor.

scenes.title: Strict Rest and Guarding the Sickroom
scenes.summary: After Chun Yuqiao's doctor agrees to twenty-four-hour on-site monitoring under strict quiet, Bu Xiaogu pledges full compliance with the medical plan and orders everyone to keep work away from the sickroom.

scenes.title: Clearing Up Misunderstandings Outside the Ward
scenes.summary: Outside Chun Yuqiao's sickroom, Bu Xiaogu gently clears up a visitor's misunderstanding, asks for help locating Xin Huimei, and slips back inside to check Chun Yuqiao's intravenous drip.

scenes.title: Never This Quiet Around You
scenes.summary: Waking briefly after a fresh drip, Chun Yuqiao remarks on how unusually hushed his office feels and teases Bu Xiaogu that nowhere stays quiet when she is around.

scenes.title: Debating the Missing Guest Overseas
scenes.summary: In an emergency conference, Kaiwen and Xingzi argue that airing the premiere while a featured guest's brother remains missing in an overseas attack would be callous.

scenes.title: Refusing to Let Chun Yuqiao Be Sidelined
scenes.summary: After Qin Xiao delivers a pointed message from DTS and rival executives move to strip ailing Chun Yuqiao of control over the show, Xingzi and Kaiwen fiercely defend their chief editor's office.

scenes.title: A Treasured Book and Loyal Walkout
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu leaves her cherished childhood book beside Chun Yuqiao to cheer him up, then steps outside to learn from Xingzi and Kaiwen that they are walking off tonight's broadcast in solidarity with their sidelined boss.

scenes.title: Rivals Take Over the Broadcast Booth
scenes.summary: Rival executives settle smugly into the control booth expecting Chun Yuqiao's existing plan and the rainy weather to hand them easy ratings.

scenes.title: Staying Beside Him as Red-Alert Rain Hits
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu tells Chun Yuqiao that Xingzi and Kaiwen stepped back from production and chooses to stay quietly by his side just as the city upgrades the rainstorm to a red alert.
scenes.location: Chun Yuqiao's office and control room

scenes.title: Singers and Audience Stranded in the Storm
scenes.summary: With less than three hours to air, Lin Jie, Qin Xiao, and the studio crew learn that Wen Simo, the guest stars, all seven finalists, and the entire audience are stranded in floodwaters while Supernova starts airing early.
scenes.location: Twelve Singers studio and control booth

scenes.title: Executives Beg Chun Yuqiao to Save the Show
scenes.summary: Panicked executives crowd into Chun Yuqiao's sickroom begging for his judgement on the stranded finale; sensing he already has a rescue plan, Bu Xiaogu Bundled up approves him stepping back in as Kaiwen restores him to the group chat.

scenes.title: Turning the City Into the Live Stage
scenes.summary: Under two hours before airtime, Chun Yuqiao abandons the empty studio, dispatches mobile camera teams and broadcast vans into the flooded streets, and rallies five live feeds to cover the storm.

scenes.title: Wen Simo Hosts From the Storm
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao links stranded host Wen Simo and the Twelve Singers finalists through Xingtian's live app, and Wen Simo opens a moving remote broadcast calling on fans and citizens to help one another through the storm.

scenes.title: Twelve Singers Tops the Trending Charts
scenes.summary: Kaiwen reports that Twelve Singers has rocketed to number one on the trending charts as viewers across the city open their homes and cars to stranded neighbours.

scenes.title: Record Ratings and Taking Leave to Care for Him
scenes.summary: After the storm broadcast wins universal acclaim and citizen solidarity, Bu Xiaogu returns Chun Yuqiao's favourite book in the hospital corridor and tells him she took annual leave to look after him.

scenes.title: Ji Xiu and Bianbian Crash the Ward
scenes.summary: Rival gossip reporters Ji Xiu and Bianbian bump into each other visiting Chun Yuqiao, trade barbs over bread and flowers, tease Bu Xiaogu about keeping bedside watch, and joke about writing Chun Yuqiao's memoirs.

scenes.title: Bianbian Promises Not to Gossip
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao banters dryly with Bianbian and makes sure he will not publish gossip about Bu Xiaogu; touched by genuine affection, Bianbian promises to keep quiet and scrambles to swap contacts with Ji Xiu.

scenes.title: Sneaking Out of the Hospital Together
scenes.summary: Spotting company executives heading upstairs for a noisy hospital visit, Chun Yuqiao persuades worried Bu Xiaogu to help him slip away to his apartment for stomach medicine and quiet rest.
scenes.location: hospital corridor and Chun Yuqiao's apartment

scenes.title: Unannounced Visitors at Chun Yuqiao's Door
scenes.summary: At Chun Yuqiao's minimalist apartment, flustered Bu Xiaogu turns down a blanket just before Xingtian's chairwoman and executives ring from outside his front door, sending Xiaogu ducking into the bedroom.
